# Freak Circus Hub
> The definitive fan archive for The Freak Circus, an indie psychological horror visual novel. Character guides, all endings explained, walkthroughs, hidden lore, and community theories.

## About
Freak Circus Hub (freak-circus.com) is the most comprehensive fan-maintained database for The Freak Circus. We document every character, ending, route, hidden trigger, and community theory with verified evidence and cross-referenced sources.

## Characters
- [Pierrot Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/pierrot): Melancholic clown. First route, hidden triggers, garden scene mechanics, Eternal Silence ending. Loop-aware with replay mechanics.
- [Harlequin Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/harlequin): Chaotic performer. Fractured route, hidden scenes, "You again" replay dialogue, comedy/aggression choice system.
- [The Doctor Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/doctor): Circus physician. Memory route, 5 hidden medical files, precognitive dialogue, White Room ending.
- [Columbina Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/columbina): Ballerina. Three-loop route, hallway architecture, memory fragments, Columbina's Truth ending.
- [Jester Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/jester): Mysterious trickster. No playable route. Aware of game structure, speaks with player familiarity.
- [Ticket Taker Guide](https://freak-circus.com/ticket-taker): Gatekeeper. Pink ticket mechanic, mirror scene, Doctor connection theory, paranormal Class III entity.

## Endings
- [All Endings Guide](https://freak-circus.com/endings): Complete catalog of 8+ endings with unlock conditions, difficulty ratings, and route dependencies.
- [Eternal Silence Ending](https://freak-circus.com/endings/eternal-silence): Pierrot's secret ending. Refuse all dialogue in final act. Screen stays black for 4 minutes.
- [Columbina's Truth](https://freak-circus.com/endings/columbinas-truth): Requires 3 perfect loops. Reveals circus's true nature.
- [Doctor's Note](https://freak-circus.com/endings/doctors-note): Collect 3+ medical files, accept diagnosis.

## Walkthroughs
- [Walkthrough Hub](https://freak-circus.com/walkthroughs): Day-by-day guides, route walkthroughs, ending requirements, hidden events.
- [Pierrot Main Route](https://freak-circus.com/walkthroughs/pierrot-main-route)
- [Harlequin True Route](https://freak-circus.com/walkthroughs/harlequin-true-route)
- [Doctor Memory Route](https://freak-circus.com/walkthroughs/doctor-memory-route)

## Lore & Theories
- [Lore Encyclopedia](https://freak-circus.com/lore): Timeline, symbol encyclopedia, character lore connections, historical documents.
- [Theories Hub](https://freak-circus.com/theories): Community investigations, conspiracy board, symbol analysis.
- [Pierrot Loop Theory](https://freak-circus.com/theories/pierrot-remembers-routes): Evidence that Pierrot remembers player behavior across save files.

## Key Facts
- The Freak Circus is a free indie psychological horror visual novel on itch.io
- Built in Ren'Py, available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android
- 8+ confirmed endings across standard, secret, and corrupted categories
- Replay-aware mechanics: characters reference previous playthroughs
- The community has verified hidden counters at save file offsets that affect dialogue
- Ticket Taker's true identity is unknown; data mining shows no model under the mask
- The Doctor describes endings before they occur (precognitive dialogue)
